summary: Round-6 Diet revamp + warm-palette revert tested on mobile viewport (390x844). All 12 functional checks passed: warm color palette restored on Dashboard/Symptoms/Ferritin/Documents/Settings/Diet (body bg rgb(242,241,239), --background 36 12% 95%, --card 36 18% 98%, --primary 209 24% 48%); diet-weekly-summary renders ABOVE day selector with correct text and live updates; pluralization correct (0 meals/1 meal/2 meals home, 'out' invariant); legacy entries without `location` field default to HOME on read and on entry-card pill; entry pills show '{Meal} · {Location}' format; weekly chart renders with 2 stacked Bar layers using #8ca3b8 (Home) and #dee5eb (Out); legend shows Home then Out (Out has 1px border); Add dialog defaults to Home active in slate-blue (#5B7C99); toggling to Out and saving correctly increments the 'Out' count in summary live. One MINOR visual issue noted: Monday 'M' x-axis tick label appears clipped/hidden due to negative left margin in BarChart (margin.left=-28) — chart renders 7 bars but only 6 tick labels are visible (T W T F S S).

issues: Monday 'M' x-axis tick label is clipped/hidden because BarChart uses margin.left=-28; chart shows 6 day labels (T W T F S S) instead of 7 (M T W T F S S). All 7 bars/slots render correctly — only the leftmost label is missing. Suggest changing margin.left to 0 (or a small negative like -10) so the M tick fits.

action_items: Adjust BarChart margin.left in /app/frontend/src/pages/Diet.jsx so Monday's 'M' x-axis label is not clipped (e.g. margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}).
critical_code_review_comments: dietAPI.add() correctly defaults location to 'Home' via spread order (location: 'Home' before ...entry, so caller-supplied location wins) — verified with 'Out' save.
dietAPI.list()/byDate() both backfill location='Home' for legacy entries — legacy a4 (no location field) renders correctly as 'LUNCH · HOME' on the card pill.
weekData useMemo computes Monday-Sunday using startOfWeek(new Date(), { weekStartsOn: 1 }) — current week, independent of viewDate. Verified summary stays consistent when navigating away from today.
Chart-only colors (#8ca3b8, #dee5eb) are kept as local constants in Diet.jsx — they don't leak into the global palette. Confirmed.

Pre-existing CSP error: Cloudflare beacon script blocked by CSP (script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:). This is the intended strict-offline behavior — confirms CSP is active and external scripts are blocked. No regression.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 4 thal.diet entries via page.evaluate spanning Mon/Tue/Wed of current week (mixed Home/Out + 1 legacy without location). Cleared at end and added 1 fresh entry to verify singular pluralization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-6 verified end-to-end. Diet page is fully working. Only design polish left: fix BarChart margin.left so Monday 'M' tick label isn't clipped. Warm palette is correctly applied on all spot-checked pages. Strict-offline CSP is still active (Cloudflare beacon blocked, as intended). PWA service worker not directly verified but not affected by color changes — main agent can self-confirm via DevTools.
rca of the issue: Minor: BarChart margin.left=-28 in Diet.jsx pulls the plot area left of the SVG origin, causing recharts to clip the first x-axis tick text. Fix: set margin.left to 0 or -10. No functional impact — only the leftmost label is hidden; all 7 day slots and bars render correctly.
